name: Prisms
description: The frame is cut into 3D prisms that turn in a cascade, like a rotating billboard, from the first clip to the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay of the last prism, as a part of the transition

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the faces darken as they turn

params.name: horizontal
params.description: Cut the frame into horizontal prisms

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color where the turning prisms leave the frame uncovered
